lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 4 visible high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is irregular with a significant wide gap in the medial torso region between the second and third visible lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line segment is abbreviated, appearing as a vertical dash that does not extend to the dorsal crest or the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A group of approximately 6-8 high-contrast white spots clustered on the lower posterior haunch, concentrated above the junction of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-posterior haunch align to form a semi-connected diagonal geometric trajectory.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate spiral trajectory, initiating with a posterior tilt from the skull before arching laterally and recurving medially at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.8 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent ventral hair fringe (shag) extending from the lower neck to the inguinal region; distinct white facial chevron and sub-orbital spots.
